items.title: Continuous Overlapping Circular Rings Fretwork Vector for CNC Router
items.description: A visually striking and highly continuous fretwork template featuring a harmonious matrix of overlapping circular rings and stylized geometric intersections. This versatile vector file is delivered in clean DXF, SVG, and DWG cutting formats, tailored for modern residential and commercial decor projects. Perfect for fabricating stylish room dividers, backlit bar features, and decorative accent walls.
